post_title: H1B 221(g) US embassy Pakistan - need some guidance
concerns_or_questions_summary: Had the H-1B visa interview at the U.S. Embassy in Pakistan and was issued a 221(g) pink slip; status has been showing 'Refused' for about two weeks. USCIS approval itself took nearly a year. Asking others how long it took for their status to change, whether it stayed 'Refused' the whole time, and how the final update came through.
